violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. -Freezer has excessive ice buildup and uncovered food in it.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Kitchen fan has dust buildup.

Handling of clean equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not handled in a manner to prevent contamination of food-contact surface. -Forks and spoons in the silverware holders need to be facing the same direction.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. The walk in cooler had products temping between 50 and 52 degrees. The air temp was 52 degrees. The thermostat was set at 50 degrees. Had owner re adjust.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Paper boats and ice cream containers on the bottom shelf by the flat grill were not inverted.
